Order No.03 Date: 12.11.2024
1.

The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Deori P.S. Case No.196 of 2021
registered under Sections 406/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners at the outset prays for withdrawal of the present anticipatory
bail application with respect to the petitioner no.1-Brahmdeo Mandal.
3.  Considering the said prayer, the anticipatory bail application with respect to the petitioner no.1-Brahmdeo Mandal is dismissed as withdrawn.

sentences.text:
So far as the petitioner no.2-Rinki Devi @ Rinki Kumari is concerned, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that she was working as cashier in the financial company of the petitioner no.1,
namely, Shrishti Soubhagaya Nidhi Ltd. at Mandro Branch on monthly salary of Rs.10,000/-.
She did not induce any person to invest money in the said company.
She has no criminal antecedent as has been stated in paragraph no.11 of the present anticipatory bail application.

She, however,
undertakes to co-operate in the ongoing investigation.
Hence, she may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

5. Learned A.P.P. opposes though opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail of the petitioner no.2, however, he submits that there is no such allegation against the said petitioner that she induced any person to invest money in the said company.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the materials available on record, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner no.2-Rinki Devi @ Rinki Kumari on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner no.2, above named, in the event of her arrest or surrender before the court below within three weeks from today, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Giridih in connection with Deori P.S. Case No.196 of 2021 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Vikas/
